items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: We used to use Begar. Sure, we used Begar. Which one? That was Emil Begar.

ctx.x: They didn't have any violin with the Maple Leaf, huh? The Maple Leaf?
Yeah, did you tell me? We used to use Begar. Sure, we used Begar. Which one? That was Emil Begar.
Yeah, not the drum or the clarinet.
